svg.title: Feasible directional derivatives on the unit circle

cc:Work.dc:title: Feasible directional derivatives on the unit circle
cc:Work.dc:description: The objective is f(x,y) = x and the constraint function is g(x,y) = (x² + y²)/2. The tangent at the leftmost point of the unit circle points up. Two equal-length gradients lie along the x-axis. The objective gradient points right and the constraint gradient points left, giving tangent derivative zero. The dashed objective contour x = 3/5 crosses the circle at b = (3/5, -4/5), where the unit tangent w points down and left. The projection of the objective gradient points up and right along the tangent line and equals (-4/5)w. A dashed perpendicular joins the objective gradient tip to the projection tip.
